notes: WheelPad is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its parameterless constructor mints 1,000,000,000 WHEELPAD once to msg.sender, the launch factory. It has no administrative powers, subsequent minting, or transfer fees. No application contracts or initialization calls are required. The pool pairs with IMD. initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from the specified market cap and total supply.
